messages:
maya: Hey team — brought up gossamer-8b in the staging catalog. Quick sanity: FP16 baseline runs clean. When I run q8 (we used the new int8 path) with rotary KV enabled, generation drifts after ~40 tokens vs FP16. Not a catastrophic fail but consistent across prompts.

liam: can you paste the run command and a minimal prompt you used?

maya: cmd I used:
```
./rt-infer --model gossamer-8b --quant q8 --kv rotary --batch 1 --sequence 256 --seed 42 --prompt-file examples/smoke.txt --dump-kv /tmp/gossamer.kv
```
prompt: "Write a short product blurb about a developer-focused inference platform."

sasha: hmm ok. do we see any NaNs or log probs exploding? also which kernel backend — cuda-fused or aten?

maya: no NaNs. logprobs look sane. runtime printed: backend=cuda-fused, kernels=auto. latency fine. divergence is in token selection — top probs shift gradually.

ryan: possible suspects: rotary scale mismatch (rotary freq table) when quantizing, or KV cache packing alignment when using q8 tensors. Could also be kv cache evictions on chunk boundary.

maya: I dumped kv for both runs (fp16 + q8). small hexdiff shows header offsets differ by 8 bytes on each block. Example diff snippet:
```
# hexdump -C fp16.kv | head -n 6
00000000  ab cd ef 01 00 00 00 10  11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88  |........"#DUfw.|
00000010
# hexdump -C q8.kv | head -n 6
00000000  ab cd ef 01 00 00 00 18  11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88  |........"#DUfw.|
```
so offsets changed (+8). maybe struct packing changed for q8 variant.

liam: that offset shift would definitely misalign KV reads -> rotary positions get applied to wrong vectors -> drift. good catch. where is the serializer defined? I can look at eng-runtime/kv_serial.cpp.

sasha: another quick check: run with --kv-compat-mode=legacy (forces old header) and see if q8 matches fp16. if it does, we know it's a header/packing problem, not rotary math.

maya: running that now...

deploy-bot: deploy started for cluster: staging-rt-04 (maya)

maya: ok ran with --kv-compat-mode=legacy — q8 output now matches fp16 for the first 200 tokens. divergence gone on my smoke prompts.

ryan: sweet. that narrows it. probable cause: when we added compact q8 tensor metadata we changed struct alignment. Need to make serializer versioned and keep backward compat.

liam: quick mitigation: add a runtime config to detect header magic/version and adapt at load time. sasha/ryan can prepare a small PR to eng-runtime that reads header.version and uses appropriate offsets.

sasha: I'll take the PR to implement versioned deserializer + unit test that compares kv roundtrip fp16 <-> q8 using random seeds. estimate: ~1.5d.

ryan: I'll add a small e2e smoke to the bringup checklist so devex doesn't hit this again: after import run q8 vs fp16 token-equivalence on 10 canonical prompts, kv dump compare.

maya: also want to flag quantization docs — the model's config currently sets rotary_scale=1.0. For gossamer-8b we might need rotary_scale=0.9 due to training freq scaling. let's add an eval to sweep rotary_scale in Optimize.

liam: action items:
- sasha: PR for versioned kv deserializer + unit tests (1.5d)
- ryan: add e2e smoke + checklist item in onboarding doc (0.5d)
- maya: run rotary_scale sweep in Optimize and record perf/quality (0.5d)
- liam: follow up on release notes and coord with eng-releases for a patch (0.25d)

maya: throwing links: kv dump compare script: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-ml/kvdiff (small helper)
smoke prompts used: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-ml/onboard-prompts/gossamer-smoke.txt

sasha: adding test plan to PR. also will include a small reproducer script:
```python
# reproducer.py (pseudo)
from rt_client import InferenceClient
cli = InferenceClient(model=\"gossamer-8b\", quant=\"q8\", kv_mode=\"rotary\")
print(cli.generate(\"Write a short product blurb about a developer-focused inference platform.\"))
```

ryan: cool. once PR merges, we'll run full quant smoke for the rest of the 8b family. tagging eng-oncall in case of runtime fallout. @eng-oncall 

deploy-bot: deploy finished for cluster: staging-rt-04 (success)

maya: thanks all. logging this thread into the onboarding intake: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-ml/onboard/gossamer-8b (I'll update with kv diffs + test artifacts). :white_check_mark:

liam: nice triage, short-term fix and a clear path. :thumbsup:

sasha: PR to come today.

ryan: dropping a checklist item in the onboarding spreadsheet now.
